description: Non-material amendment to planning permission ref. 78935/APP/2025/2287, dated 16-01-26 (Creation of 5no. self-contained flats with associated cycle and bin storage, following the change of use of first floor from office (Class E) to residential (Class C3), the erection of a two storey rear extension and alterations to rear building at first floor level and the retention and reconfiguration of the Class E unit at ground floor level with alterations to fenestration.) to reconfigure approved ground floor layout.
decision_conditions: The submitted floor plan indicates alterations that would necessitate changes to the approved elevations. However, no amended elevation drawings have been submitted as part of the application. In the absence of sufficient information to assess the resulting changes to the external appearance of the building, the Local Planning Authority cannot conclude that the proposed amendment is non-material within the meaning of Section 96A of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
